# git.checkout

Switch an existing git working tree to a specified ref

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `dest` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `force` | boolean | No | - |
| `ref` | string | **Yes** | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
